skill.name: telegram-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with Telegram or needs workflows for chat summaries and drafts, structured extraction, history exports, channel publishing, scheduled messages, sticker packs, compliant notifications, bots, devices, or Telegram guidance. Routes each workflow by identity, selected client, durable state, runtime availability, and consequence among file and content tools, Telegram Web in My Browser, Telegram Desktop through Computer Use, and a separately verified official Bot API runtime.
skill.userDescription: Summarize, organize, export, and manage Telegram chat and channel workflows.
exampleQuestions: Summarize key decisions from my exported Telegram chat.
Draft a Telegram channel announcement for review.
Help me organize a Telegram history export.
